انحصروا (form VII)
# اِنْحَصَرُوا (inḥaṣarū) /in.ħa.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# اِنْحَصِرُوا (inḥaṣirū) /in.ħa.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
